cut_line.failMessage: Someone blocks you. You stay put.

cut_line_yourself.successMessage: You muscle your way forward. It worked.
cut_line_yourself.failMessage: The crowd pushes back. You lose your spot.

line_advance_easy.successMessage: The line shuffles forward. One person ahead of you steps away.

line_advance_medium.successMessage: A gap opens ahead. You move up one spot.
line_advance_medium.failMessage: The line holds still. Someone up front is arguing.

line_advance_hard.failMessage: Stalled. A clipboard appears. More waiting.

line_advance_chaos.successMessage: Against all odds, you slip forward through the crowd.
line_advance_chaos.failMessage: A train announcement echoes. Everyone surges the wrong way.

phone_distraction.successMessage: A viral video kills five minutes. The line moved while you scrolled.
phone_distraction.failMessage: Your battery dies. Now you're just standing here.

penn_survival.successMessage: You plant your feet and hold your ground.
penn_survival.failMessage: The crowd swallows you. You lose your spot and your composure.

doctor_called.successMessage: A nurse calls a name. Three people ahead leave at once.
doctor_called.failMessage: The receptionist says running behind. Of course.

flight_delay.successMessage: First class boards elsewhere. Your line finally twitches forward.
flight_delay.failMessage: Gate change announced. Half the line needs to relocate.
